# Yellowmetal (yellowmetal.store)

Yellowmetal Plants & Equipment Ltd hires, sells and manages heavy construction equipment in Nigeria from Festac Town, Lagos. Rates come from the Buildocrat Nigeria Construction Rate Book (rates.buildocrat.store), updated 2026-10-15. Requests close on WhatsApp +234 803 920 4361.
